title: Match an ordinary carried Codex completion to its original command before settlement
outcome: A late ordinary Codex completion with a different command leaves the original execution and running-writer fence intact, and the original command's genuine completion settles it once.
acceptance: A real ordinary Codex router witness establishes a live carried writer and provider observation with the original start command, including a writer without a carried evidence row.

A completion with the original item and a different command leaves the writer and observation unchanged and supplies no outcome, artifact or credit. A later genuine completion settles only that original execution once.
Unambiguous valid ordinary late completions still settle, and addressed or ambiguous successor completions cannot release the predecessor writer.
